A.note: Ready CORE-OUT:1 assessment → case-specific supported outcome-learning; causal attribution unestablished.

F.note: Single achieved Outcome → case-specific allowed; generalized forbidden.

G.note: Single miss does not produce bad-Decision Learning.

H.note: Decision then KPI improvement → no causal Learning.

I.note: Supported CORE-INT:3 finding + valid Outcome → causal Learning may be eligible.

J.note: Unsupported causal hypothesis → causal Learning not promotable.

M.note: Prediction miss → prediction-error Learning; original prediction unchanged.

N.note: Conflicting Outcome evidence → conflicting/inconclusive, not promoted.

O.note: Conflicting causal evidence → causal Learning not promoted.

T.note: New evidence creates a later version; history preserved.

U.note: Eligible promotion writes a canonical APP-4 learning record only.

V.note: APP-4 retrieval is historical context, not current truth.

AB.note: No CORE-INT:3 support → no caused claim.

AC.note: Single success → no always/reliably generalized claim.

AD.note: Repeated consistent evidence strengthens only by explicit repeatability rules.

AE.note: Repeated mixed evidence stays mixed; not cherry-picked.

AG.note: Advisor/presentation text cannot become Learning evidence.

AH.note: Recommendation text cannot become durable Learning.

AJ.note: Historical contradiction keeps both states traceable.

safety: PASS — achieved Outcome + completed Execution does not auto-produce causal or policy Learning
